title: channel
summary: The player-facing channel surface now matches current Benilla: JOIN/LEAVE/LIST plus the complete PASSWORD-through-MODERATE CMSG administration block, strict 32-type SMSG_CHANNEL_NOTIFY tails, SMSG_CHANNEL_LIST rosters, stable server-confirmed numbering, law-owned slash routing, and ChatFrame composition are wired.

openItems.text: CMSG_JOIN_CHANNEL / CMSG_LEAVE_CHANNEL: no senders - custom/world channels cannot be joined
openItems.resolution: 2026-08-22: exact cstring CMSG_JOIN_CHANNEL and CMSG_LEAVE_CHANNEL writers are exposed through WorldSession/NetworkClient and the ChatFrame slash router.

openItems.text: CMSG_CHANNEL_* moderation family (LIST, PASSWORD, OWNER, SET_OWNER, MODERATOR, UNMODERATOR, MUTE, UNMUTE, INVITE, KICK, BAN, UNBAN, ANNOUNCEMENTS, MODERATE): no senders
openItems.resolution: 2026-08-23: all thirteen 0x009C-0x00A8 writers use the exact channel cstring or channel+value cstring body, are exposed through WorldSession/NetworkClient, and route through ChatChannelLaw with numeric selectors and collision-safe channel aliases. Focused and full clinical suites pass.

openItems.text: SMSG_CHANNEL_NOTIFY: no handler (join/leave/kick/invite/owner notices with typed tails are undecodable)
openItems.resolution: 2026-08-22: ChannelPackets strictly parses all 0x00-0x1F typed tails and GameLoop dispatches them through deferred name resolution and ChatChannelLaw composition.
2026-08-22: ChannelPackets validates the channel/flags/count/(guid,flags) roster body and GameLoop posts the reference roster-count line.
